OPTION_FRIEREN_MAGIC_SHOP.name: Magic Shop
OPTION_FRIEREN_MAGIC_SHOP.description: Choose 2 tools to add to your Magic Deck, then use them in your Magic Book. Uses 1 Rest Site action.
OPTION_FRIEREN_SUMMON_DRAGON.name: Summon Shenron!
OPTION_FRIEREN_SUMMON_DRAGON.description: Consume [gold]seven Dragon Balls[/gold] to ask [green]Shenron[/green] for one [gold]wish[/gold]. Does not use a camp action.
